Winning numbers for the $529M jackpot
 Fernando Cervantes Jr. USA TODAY Updated Nov. 10, 2026, 11:20 p.m. ET Hear this story The Mega Millions jackpot climbed to $529 million ahead of the Tuesday, Nov. 10, drawing, with a cash value of $224.3 million.
 If someone wins the jackpot, they’ll have two options : take home a one-time, lump-sum cash payment or receive an immediate payment followed by annual checks, each 5% larger than the previous year.
 The last time someone won the Mega Millions was on July 28 when a Florida player took home a staggering $800 million jackpot with a cash value of $344.2 million. According to Florida lottery officials, the winning ticket was sold at a Wawa in Bradenton, Florida.
 With Tuesday’s Mega Millions drawing only hours away, here is what you need to know.
 What are the winning Mega Millions numbers for Nov. 10, 2026?
 The winning numbers for the Tuesday, Nov. 10, Mega Millions drawing are: 2, 18, 25, 30, 65 , and the Mega Ball is 22. 
 USA TODAY Shopping: Shop sales in tech, home, fashion, beauty & more curated by our editors. When is the next Mega Millions drawing?
 The next Mega Millions drawing is scheduled for Friday, Nov. 13, at 11 p.m. ET.
 How to play the Mega Millions
 Mega Millions tickets are sold at convenience stores, gas stations, grocery stores, and other lottery retailers. Some states also allow online purchases.
 Players choose five white-ball numbers from 1 to 70 and one gold Mega Ball number from 1 to 24. Don't want to pick your own? Ask for a Quick Pick, and numbers will be generated for you.
 Mega Millions tickets now come with a built-in multiplier that boosts non-jackpot prizes by two, three, four, five, or 10 times. Previously, players had to pay extra to add the Megaplier option.
